notes.title: Dev Log 1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312809/acd97e2da66910eb5b39acac1973dcc2cdccfded.png

Gather round, Lost Souls. 


For the very first time, enter our mysterious world of development as we shine a light on what we are working on behind-the-scenes throughout April!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312809/e47b62a5a505b3aa70b1c046885eaa2b5f083dfd.png

We have reworked the detection system, so that Zuzu can better detect other characters throughout their journey, and added some new scenes for them to explore too!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312809/be151b97f3ed15a4a42d4768e127e79a69e4586e.gif


We’ve improved not only optimizations on the world level loader, but also the accessibility of the game, with added options for the sound, dialogue, speed, and more! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312809/3ba3c44a305945fcaa1d3c41578ad466a8afe400.gif


This coincides with our reworked sound system - now including 3D sounds - to add a natural immersiveness. 

We’re also excited to reveal that we’ve integrated some important Steam features such as achievements, and added further improvements to the save system! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312809/ebecda520f80c4f06f5b39ff7f5b17d8a5fcb732.gif


 What has the Audio Team been up to? 
 
  Creating music tracks for the new levels.
  Creating new cave soundscapes based on real locations in Greece.
  Creating additional SFX for all the characters. 
 Creating a new set of SFX for the interface. 
 Reworked all the sounds for the forest level.
  Reworked all the sounds for the graveyard level.
  Improved the quality of some sounds.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312809/e47b62a5a505b3aa70b1c046885eaa2b5f083dfd.png

Be sure to wishlist us below to get the latest devlog updates, and to be one of the first to experience our whimsical yet challenging world this 2022!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574780/Skaramazuzu/

 We are also always active over on the official Discord Server, as well as on Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram. 

Until next time,


The Skaramazuzu Community Management Team

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.6.3
notes.content:
It's been a great journey, everyone!

With your input, we've been able to catch some nasty bugs and made a few gameplay/interface adjustments.

Thank you all for your feedback, it means a lot to us!

Demo Patch 0.6.3

Added:
- Now there is a visual indicator for the Journal Update.
- Added text indicator for the Journal Update
- Now there is a cancel option when you enter a conversation
- Added item sound also when an item is removed from the inventory
- Now the black bars animate when you enter a conversation
- A new camera movement
- Enter key now acts as Interaction, Submit button

Adjustments:
- Increased the dialogue text speed
- Now Skaramazuzu rotates almost immediately when reach the hotspot destination
- The control button selection now belongs to the Main Menu
- Decrease the size of the character name text
- Adjust the volume of the ambient sounds
- Decrease the time required pressing the button to enter a vertical door

Bugfixes:
- Sometimes Skaramazuzu didn't want to rotate correctly. Now Zuzu is more motivated
- In some situations the save system didn't track correctly the current scene
- The Bird in some situations didn't like the idle animations.

Issues:
- Ultrawide monitors are still not supported. A future patch will add support for 21:9
